summary: Comprehensive test of SaloneHCM. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED including auth, employees CRUD, payroll preview/run (employee_count=10, paye>0, nassit>0), compliance summary, NRA export, leave create/decision, attendance, dashboard, AI assistant chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM, employee role isolation (403 on create, my-payslip works). Frontend: login works, all 6 nav routes (Dashboard, Employees, Payroll, Compliance, Leave, Attendance, Assistant) load without JS errors. Dashboard renders KPIs (Headcount 10, Monthly Payroll SLE 53,150, Last Run Net SLE 41,482.75) and bar chart of departments.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid attributes on any interactive elements (login form, nav links, Run Payroll button, Assistant chat input/send, etc.). Review request explicitly required these for testability.
Console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render. Charts eventually render but flicker. Likely missing minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.
Uses native browser date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar component. Inconsistent with rest of UI.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to: login email/password/submit, sidebar nav links (nav-dashboard, nav-employees, etc.), Run Payroll button, Employees Add/Edit/Delete actions, Assistant chat textarea + send button, Leave Create/Approve/Reject, Attendance submit.
Fix Recharts container sizing: ensure parent has explicit height or pass minHeight to ResponsiveContainer to remove width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
Optional: Replace native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker on Attendance page for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False, but login endpoint also sets httpOnly cookie via set_auth_cookie. Cookie auth will be unusable cross-origin (browsers reject SameSite=None+Secure cookies without credentialed CORS). Bearer token works (used by frontend) so functionally OK, but the cookie-set is dead code or misleading.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Should migrate to lifespan context manager.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout requirement).

seed() creates duplicate employee user accounts on each restart only if employees collection is empty; bcrypt for 10 employees + admin runs synchronously on startup — slow cold start. Acceptable but worth noting.

/api/employees PUT replaces entire doc with EmployeeIn fields, dropping created_at since model_dump excludes it (but matched_count check is fine; created_at preserved because $set only updates given fields — verified OK).
/api/leave date diff uses datetime.fromisoformat on YYYY-MM-DD which works but is fragile; consider validation.
AI assistant: history is loaded from db but never injected into LlmChat, so multi-turn context is not preserved across requests (LlmChat instance is created fresh each call).
Missing data-testid attributes across the UI is a code-quality + testability gap.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 1 admin + 10 employees + 10 employee user accounts on startup (verified). No additional test seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid (16/16). Main remaining work is frontend testability: add data-testid attributes per action_items. Recharts warnings are non-blocking. AI assistant chat works end-to-end (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key returns correct NASSIT info). Bearer token auth via Authorization header is the live auth path; cookie-set is unused.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. data-testid omission is a deliberate scope gap by E1 against review_request bullet 12.
